tool_args.rationale: The gradient-sensitive siphon with a signed square-root term fits all five target-horizon observations to rounding precision. It identifies vmax near 7.128, rho near 0.690, and a positive branch coefficient near 0.425, all within the warm-start box. Submit this law for fresh confirmation without buying another probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Even an unconstrained drift fit has pilot RMSE of 0.0159, versus 1.6e-8 for the square-root branch. The existing observations distinguish the branches at their reported precision.
The maximum observed sink gradient is 2.20, below the 2.36 trigger for investigating a supercritical regime.
The pilot already covers the target horizon and identifies all three parameters of the reduced law.
